boundary: Installed Chrome extension artifact, distinct from @oai npm packages. @core/browser-extension is this project's package name; no claim of an original @oai/browser-extension package.
thirdParty: This inspected transport uses Chrome nativeMessaging/alarms and standard timers. Sentry 10.48.0 is separately bundled; not copied into the transport. Broader dependency audit remains pending.
remaining: Production lower-layer wiring (shared lease startup wiring, favicon foundation wiring and page consumer, shared debugger startup wiring, production network-policy wiring and real-browser validation, SIWC, overlay/monitors, mentions, startup), manifest and build/install packaging; native messaging host executable remains external.
sharedImplementation: Browser-service to and extension fc share protocol methods but preserve their distinct transport-field initialization order. Core extraction and factory are project refactoring boundaries. Request-header template parsing and expansion are shared between browser VC/u5 and extension cs/ls via project-created @core/core/requestHeaders. Host/origin normalization and matching now share @core/core/originPatterns; differential tests compare the extension ic/up/gp closure.
composition: createExtensionBrowserFoundation is project-authored assembly of restored identity, lease, tab groups, debugger, tab, network-policy/compiler/predicate/inspector, session and dispatcher components. Handler and sessions share one network policy singleton and host timers. It is not full original dR startup.
